title: Toll on Public Service at Forefront of Fight against COVID-19 Pandemic and Measures to Ensure It Remains Competitive
what_it_is: Toll on Public Service at Forefront of Fight against COVID-19 Pandemic and Measures to Ensure It Remains Competitive

sections.label: Civil Service resignation rate peak
sections.summary: The Management Executive Scheme resignation rate hit a 10-year peak of 9.9% in 2021, with ICT facing higher rates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The resignation rate for the Management Executive Scheme, the largest generic scheme in the Civil Service, reached a 10-year peak of 9.9% in 2021 and the attrition has clearly picked up momentum in the last six months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Some specific segments, such as Info-communication Technology (ICT), are experiencing elevated competitive pressures in the face of talent shortages and facing resignation rates that are even higher.

sections.label: Remote work and attrition risk
sections.summary: Remote work has blurred work-life lines, risking higher Public Service attrition as the economy recovers and private sector offers increase.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The shift to remote work has also blurred the line between work and life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: There is a risk of an increase in attrition from the Public Service, as the economy recovers, and job offers from the private sector increase.

sections.label: ICT talent competition challenge
sections.summary: ICT talent is the area of concern, and the hot private sector market makes getting a fair share a big challenge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In this particular area, the specific area of concern will be our ICT talent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Given the hot market in the private sector for ICT talent, it is, indeed, a big challenge for us to get our fair share of talent.

sections.label: MX scheme 2021 attrition
sections.summary: The Minister shared that the haemorrhage in 2021 for Public Service officers on the MX scheme was 9.9%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Minister shared that the haemorrhage in 2021 with respect to Public Service officers on the MX scheme of service was 9.9%.

sections.label: Multi-pronged ICT approach
sections.summary: Meeting the Government's ICT needs as a whole uses a multi-pronged approach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: On the second part, it is an important question because in meeting our ICT needs for the Government as a whole, we do apply a multi-pronged approach.

sections.label: Rationalising ICT manpower demand
sections.summary: The third prong to meet ICT needs is to rationalise the way ICT manpower is demanded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The third prong that we use to meet our own ICT needs is also to rationalise the way we demand ICT manpower.
